keyword: where can you see artemis 2 launch
claims: The Artemis 2 launch can be viewed in person from Florida’s Space Coast (Cape Canaveral/Cocoa Beach).
Popular in-person viewing spots for the Artemis 2 launch include Playalinda Beach, Space View Park, and Marina Park.
Livestreams of the Artemis 2 launch are available on NASA+, YouTube, Prime Video, and FOX Weather.
Titusville (Space View Park), Cocoa Beach, Jetty Park, and beaches along Cape Canaveral offer best visibility for in-person viewing of the Artemis 2 launch.
Playalinda Beach has limited access for viewing the Artemis 2 launch (frequently fills up early or closes).
The Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex offers ticketed packages for viewing the Artemis 2 launch.
The Artemis 2 launch is visible across most of Florida, including Orlando, Tampa, and Jacksonville, for about 70 seconds after launch.
There is potential viewing of the Artemis 2 launch from coastal Georgia, such as Savannah.
Official NASA coverage of the Artemis 2 launch is available on NASA+ Website, NASA YouTube, and the NASA App.
Streaming services for the Artemis 2 launch include Prime Video (Live TV section), CBS News 24/7, and YouTube.
